notes:
I found two places with their own pages. I read neither page for the exact days of the visit. I also couldn't run a search for playgrounds, and Ottawa has no zoo or aquarium among the results. Two picks:

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Canada Science and Technology Museum, 1867 St. Laurent Blvd, Ottawa",
      "age_fit": "Youth (ages 3 to 17); child age 2 and under free",
      "when": "Sun Aug 30, Tue Sept 1, Wed Sept 2: 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Monday closed per their page",
      "price": "$12.50 youth (3-17), family $51 (6 people, max 2 adults), taxes not included",
      "source_name": "Ingenium (Canada Science and Technology Museum)"
    },
    {
      "name": "Canadian Children's Museum, inside the Canadian Museum of History, 100 Laurier St, Gatineau",
      "age_fit": "Child (3-12); infant (0-2) free",
      "price": "$18 child (3-12), $25 adult, family $68 (6 max, up to 2 adults), taxes not included",
      "source_name": "Canadian Museum of History"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Canada Science and Technology Museum**
- 
Their page lists Monday as closed and shows Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday as 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
 Wednesday was cut off in what I read, so I'm assuming the same hours.
- That puts Aug 30, Sept 1 and Sept 2 inside opening hours and Monday Aug 31 outside them. One third-party listing shows daily hours for May to August, so ring ahead if Aug 31 matters.
- 
Admission is free daily from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m.

- 
The museum is closed Sept. 14 to 18, 2026
, which is after the visit.
- The ZOOOM children's zone is for ages eight and under, but I saw that on a guide site, not on the museum's own page.

**Canadian Children's Museum**
- 
It sits inside the Museum of History, and one general admission ticket covers both.

- 
Everyone needs a timed ticket, whatever their age.
 
At busy times, entry to the Children's Museum is first-come, first-served.

- The hours on their page start Sept. 8, which is after the visit. I have no hours for Aug 30 to Sept 2, so I left `when` out. Check their site or ring before going.
- It is in Gatineau, Quebec, across the river from Ottawa.

**Canadian Museum of Nature**
- I left it out because its own page gave me only that day's hours. It had no age range and no hours for your dates.
- Third-party listings suggest it is closed on Tuesdays, which would include Sept 1. I couldn't confirm that on their site.
